```{r}
#LASSO COX FUNCTION

run_lasso_cox <- function(data, time_col, event_col, endpoint_name) {
  
  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("ENDPOINT:", endpoint_name, "| N =", nrow(data), "\n")
  




  # Design matrix and survival response
  X <- as.matrix(data[, leiden_cols])
  
  
  y <- Surv(data[[time_col]], data[[event_col]])
  
  set.seed(42)
  cv_fit <- cv.glmnet(
    X, y,
    family   = "cox",
```


```{r}
alpha    =  1,
    nfolds   = 10,
    cox.ties = "efron"
  )
  
  cat("Lambda min:", round(cv_fit$lambda.min, 5), "\n")
  cat("Lambda 1se:", round(cv_fit$lambda.1se, 5), "\n")
  
  coefs    <- coef(cv_fit, s = "lambda.min")
  selected <- data.frame(
    metacluster = rownames(coefs),
    coefficient = as.numeric(coefs)
  ) %>%
    filter(coefficient != 0) %>%
    mutate(
      HR        = round(exp(coefficient), 3),
      direction = ifelse(coefficient > 0, "POOR prognosis", "GOOD prognosis")
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(coefficient)))
  
  cat("\nSelected metaclusters at lambda.min (n =", nrow(selected), "):\n")
  print(selected)
  
  plot(cv_fit, main = paste("LASSO CV -", endpoint_name))
  
  return(list(cv_fit = cv_fit, selected = selected))
}


dfs_lasso <-run_lasso_cox(
  data = merged_df_dfs,
  time_col = "dfs_months",
  event_col ="dfs_event",
  endpoint_name ="DFS"
)
```

```{r}
# Build formula: Surv ~ all metaclusters
cox_formula <- as.formula(
  paste(
    "Surv(dfs_months, dfs_event) ~",
    paste(leiden_cols, collapse = " + ")
  )
)

full_cox <- coxph(cox_formula, data = merged_df_dfs)
summary(full_cox)
```

```{r}
set.seed(123)
B <- 200  # number of bootstrap samples (adjust as time allows)

boot_coefs <- replicate(B, {
  # resample patients with replacement
  idx <- sample(seq_len(nrow(merged_df_dfs)), replace = TRUE)
  boot_data <- merged_df_dfs[idx, ]

  fit <- coxph(cox_formula, data = boot_data)
  coef(fit)  # named vector of coefficients
})

# boot_coefs is a matrix: rows = metaclusters, cols = bootstrap reps
boot_coefs <- t(boot_coefs)  # make rows = reps, cols = metaclusters
```
```{r}
boot_summary <- apply(boot_coefs, 2, function(b) {
  b <- b[is.finite(b)]  # drop any NA/Inf if a fit failed
  c(
    mean   = mean(b),
    sd     = sd(b),
    q2.5   = quantile(b, 0.025),
    q97.5  = quantile(b, 0.975),
    pos_pr = mean(b > 0),
    neg_pr = mean(b < 0)
  )
})
boot_summary <- t(boot_summary)
boot_summary
```
```{r}
names(boot_df_high)

# Turn boot_summary into a data frame and add HR
boot_df <- as.data.frame(boot_summary)
boot_df$metacluster <- rownames(boot_summary)
```

```{r}
# 1. Filter (optionally) to clusters whose CI excludes 0 on log-HR scale
#    i.e. both bounds > 0 or both < 0
stable_idx <- which(
  (boot_df$`q2.5.2.5%` > 0 & boot_df$`q97.5.97.5%` > 0) |
  (boot_df$`q2.5.2.5%` < 0 & boot_df$`q97.5.97.5%` < 0)
)
stable_df <- boot_df[stable_idx, ]

# 2. Sort by HR_mean
stable_high <- stable_df[order(-stable_df$HR_mean), ]
stable_low  <- stable_df[order( stable_df$HR_mean), ]

# 3. Get top 5 highest-HR clusters
top5 <- head(stable_high, 5)

# 4. For the lowest-HR list, exclude any clusters already in top5
remaining <- stable_low[!(stable_low$metacluster %in% top5$metacluster), ]

bot5 <- head(remaining, 5)

# 5. Inspect
top5[, c("metacluster", "HR_mean", "q2.5.2.5%", "q97.5.97.5%", "pos_pr")]
bot5[, c("metacluster", "HR_mean", "q2.5.2.5%", "q97.5.97.5%", "pos_pr")]

nrow(boot_df)
sum(boot_df$`q2.5.2.5%` > 0 & boot_df$`q97.5.97.5%` > 0)
sum(boot_df$`q2.5.2.5%` < 0 & boot_df$`q97.5.97.5%` < 0)

# Sign-stable if coefficient is positive >= 0.8 of the time, or negative >= 0.8
stable_idx <- which(
  boot_df$pos_pr >= 0.8 | boot_df$neg_pr >= 0.8
)
stable_df <- boot_df[stable_idx, ]
nrow(stable_df)

# Sort by HR_mean within stable_df
stable_high <- stable_df[order(-stable_df$HR_mean), ]
stable_low  <- stable_df[order( stable_df$HR_mean), ]

# Top 5 highest HR
top5 <- head(stable_high, 5)

# Exclude these from the low list
remaining <- stable_low[!(stable_low$metacluster %in% top5$metacluster), ]

# Bottom 5 lowest HR from remaining
bot5 <- head(remaining, 5)

top5[, c("metacluster", "HR_mean", "q2.5.2.5%", "q97.5.97.5%", "pos_pr")]
bot5[, c("metacluster", "HR_mean", "q2.5.2.5%", "q97.5.97.5%", "pos_pr")]
saveRDS(top5, file = "dfs_top5_metaclusters.rds")
saveRDS(bot5, file = "dfs_bot5_metaclusters.rds")
```

```{r}
df_compare <- merged_df_dfs %>%
  mutate(
    dfs_group = factor(
      dfs_event,
      levels=c(0,1),
      labels =c("No DFS event", "DFS event")
    )
  )


table(df_compare$dfs_group, useNA = "ifany")
# should show 97 No_DFS_event, 24 DFS_event (as you saw)



mc_prob_stats <- map_dfr(leiden_cols, function(col) {
  p <- df_compare[[col]]  # probabilities for this cluster

  # Split by DFS group (note the spaces!)
  p_event   <- p[df_compare$dfs_group == "DFS event"]
  p_noevent <- p[df_compare$dfs_group == "No DFS event"]

  # Remove NAs
  p_event   <- p_event[!is.na(p_event)]
  p_noevent <- p_noevent[!is.na(p_noevent)]

  # If either group has no data, return NA row for this cluster
  if (length(p_event) == 0 || length(p_noevent) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      metacluster          = col,
      mean_prob_event      = NA_real_,
      mean_prob_noevent    = NA_real_,
      median_prob_event    = NA_real_,
      median_prob_noevent  = NA_real_,
      p_value              = NA_real_
    ))
  }

  # Non-parametric comparison of distributions
  wt <- wilcox.test(p_event, p_noevent, exact = FALSE)

  tibble(
    metacluster          = col,
    mean_prob_event      = mean(p_event),
    mean_prob_noevent    = mean(p_noevent),
    median_prob_event    = median(p_event),
    median_prob_noevent  = median(p_noevent),
    p_value              = wt$p.value
  )
})

mc_prob_stats <- mc_prob_stats %>% arrange(p_value)
mc_prob_stats
```


```{r}
event_clusters <- mc_prob_stats %>%
  filter(mean_prob_event > mean_prob_noevent) %>%
```

```{r}

# per-patient total bad/good abundance
bad_abund  <- rowSums(df_compare[, bad_cols,  drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
good_abund <- rowSums(df_compare[, good_cols, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)

patient_scores <- data.frame(
  patient_id = rownames(df_compare),
  good_abund = good_abund,
  bad_abund  = bad_abund
)

# RAW prognosis score (no log)
patient_scores$score_raw <- patient_scores$bad_abund - patient_scores$good_abund

ggplot(patient_scores, aes(x = score_raw)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, colour = "black", fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    x = "Raw prognosis score (bad - good MC abundance)",
    y = "Number of patients"
  )
```
